brief:
Today marks one year since the death of Abu Ubaidah, the military spokesman for the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the armed wing of Hamas, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Ubaidah, whose real name was Hazifah Samir Abdullah al-Kahlout, served as a primary public voice for the Palestinian militant organization's military operations and communications.

The spokesman became a recognizable figure in Gaza through his regular statements and announcements representing the group's armed activities. He held the position until his death, maintaining a central role in conveying the organization's military messaging to both local and international audiences during his tenure with the Qassam Brigades.
